artworks.title: The Virgin, Holding a Pear, with the Child
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman seated outdoors, cradling an infant in her arms. The woman has closed eyes and long, wavy hair with a headpiece, wearing a layered gown with fur trim, and a belt. The infant has curly hair and reaches out, being supported by the woman. There is a tree trunk in the background, grass in the bottom right corner, and a tattered cloth covering the woman's legs with a few stones and an inscription at the bottom.

artworks.title: The Virgin and Child with a Parrot
artworks.description: The image shows a person sitting with a child standing next to them. The person has distinct facial features, long hair, and wears flowing clothing with voluminous sleeves. The child has curly hair and holds a bird in their hand. The person holds an apple close to the child. In the background, there is a tree with bare branches and a castle or large building labeled "S. MARIA."

artworks.title: The Wedding at Cana
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group dining scene. The drawing features several figures seated around a table that is laden with dishes. The architecture of the room shows arched windows that open to a view with trees, through which light streams in. A bird perches on the sill of one of these windows. The composition is densely packed with intricate details, including the varied postures and gestures of the people in the scene. The style reflects techniques used in early European printmaking.

artworks.title: Christ and the Woman of Samaria
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures gathered around a well or water source. The detailed engraving captures a scene where an individual with a vessel or jug is reaching towards an elderly, bearded figure who is seated by the well. Several other figures are positioned around them, each showing expressions of interest or conversation. The scene features a pulley system at the well and various other containers, with rolling hills and a distant cityscape in the backdrop. The overall composition appears to convey a narrative moment.

artworks.title: Christ at the Table of Simon the Pharisee
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people seated around a table with various objects and food on display. The scene features six figures gathered around a circular table, which is adorned with a large platter containing a bird, a goblet, and a jug. The figures are dressed in richly detailed garments and they appear to be engaged in conversation. The background shows a landscape view through two arched windows, with a shelf of books and a large jug in the room. The artwork features intricate linework and shading reminiscent of engravings or etchings from the 16th century.

artworks.title: Christ as Man of Sorrows at the Foot of the Cross
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a man holding a chalice and a piece of bread in each hand. The figure is positioned in front of a ladder and a tree. The man has a crown of thorns, a halo-like glow around his head, a beard, long hair, and is barefoot. His body is wrapped with a cloth, and he is standing on rocky ground with scattered stones. The background has a pattern of dense, crosshatched lines. In the lower-right corner, there is a tablet with the date "1520" and the initials "ISP."

artworks.title: Head of Christ
artworks.description: The image is an engraving showing a close-up of an individual's face, displaying from the top of their head to the chin. The person is positioned facing forward and is wearing a crown of thorns on their head. Their facial features include a somber expression with downward-cast eyes, a long, flowing beard, and shoulder-length hair that is slightly wavy. The engraving style emphasizes the texture of the hair and the crown of thorns. The person is not shown wearing any visible clothing or jewelry, nor holding any objects. The background of the image consists of fine lines and shading that suggests a neutral backdrop. At the bottom of the image, there is an inscription that reads "ISP 1520."

artworks.title: Head of Christ
artworks.description: The image is a close-up portrait showing only the head and shoulders of a man. The man is facing slightly to the right, with his eyes looking upwards. He has a full beard and mustache, with curly hair partially covering his forehead. On his head, he wears a crown made of twisted, thorny branches. The background is simple and unadorned. There is a date, "1520," and a monogram in the top left corner.

artworks.title: Christ on the Globe
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length figure standing on a small sphere in a dynamic pose. The person has a bearded face, long hair, and is holding a staff with a cross and banner. They wear a draped garment and are surrounded by cherubic faces and wings against a cloud-filled background. Above them, a dove radiates light. The scene is enclosed within an oval design with inscriptions along the inner edges.

artworks.title: Departure of the Prodigal Son
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a medieval scene with a castle in the background and individuals in period clothing in the foreground. The scene includes three individuals in medieval attire - one with a beard and a cap handing something to another. Behind them, a third figure stands observing. Trees and shrubs are present in the natural environment. The castle features multiple windows and turrets, and the distant background shows buildings and hills. The drawing is detailed with line work emphasizing textures and shadows typical of the period's art style.

artworks.title: The Prodigal Son Wasting His Fortune
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of elegantly dressed figures gathered around a table in a garden setting. The image shows finely dressed people engaging with each other beside a round table adorned with food and drink, under a rustic natural setting of trees and shrubs. The figures appear to be conversing or enjoying each other's company at the table, which is set with plates, a goblet, and a flask, indicating a moment of leisure or festivity. The background features nature with abundant foliage and detailed planter pots, suggesting a refined, cultivated environment.

artworks.title: The Prodigal Son Tending the Swine
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a landscape with a figure leaning on a staff among a group of pigs in a wooded area. The foreground has several trees and the background shows rocky outcrops and distant hills. The style is detailed with precise line work, capturing the texture of the landscape, the fur of the pigs, and the folds in the figure's garments. The drawing's composition conveys a pastoral setting with a sense of harmony and serenity, while the Latin inscription at the top adds an additional layer of historical or narrative context to the artwork.

artworks.title: The Return of the Prodigal Son
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing depicting a pastoral scene with various figures engaging in agricultural and domestic tasks. One figure is preparing an animal for a feast, two figures are having an emotional reunion under a tree, and another figure is standing nearby. In the background, a figure is operating a plow near a castle-like structure and natural foliage. The image includes text at the top for context.

artworks.title: Children Playing with a Bitch and Three Young Dogs
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a group of cherubic figures in various poses. The figures, reminiscent of putti, have playful and dynamic stances. They have round, youthful faces, small features, and curly hair. Some are interacting while others are focused on their activities. One figure wears a draped garment, while the others are unclothed. Two figures are holding long arrows. Small animals, including two dogs, are also present. The background has a hatched pattern for depth.

artworks.title: Saint Bartholomew and Saint Matthias
artworks.description: The image shows a portrayal of two men standing closely together facing each other. The man on the left has a long beard and is bald, wearing a robe and holding a sword. The man on the right has short hair and a beard, wearing a tied robe and holding an axe. Both men are barefoot. The background includes a cottage surrounded by trees, with a cloud formation above. The image is signed and dated "1520" in the upper left corner.

artworks.title: Saint Peter
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length view of a male figure identified as St. Simon Peter. He stands upright with a slight turn to his right. His facial features include a serious expression, a prominent forehead, a strong nose, and a thick beard and mustache. His hair is curly and short with a receding hairline. He wears flowing robes, with one draped over his shoulders and the other covering his feet. He holds a large key in his right hand. Small plants grow around his feet, and he stands on rough ground. Engraved text identifies him as "S. SIMON PETRVS." Near his feet, there is a stone marked with the year 1545 and the initials "LSB." The background is plain with no additional elements.

artworks.title: Saint Andrew
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing and leaning on a diagonal cross made of two wooden beams, holding an open book. He has a long, bushy beard, short curly hair, and is wearing a robe with a cloak draped over his shoulders. He is barefoot on rocky ground, with two cylindrical objects hanging from his belt. In the background, there is a simple fence with twisted branches and small plants growing near it. The artwork is rendered in a monochrome style with intricate lines and shading.

artworks.title: Saint James the Less
artworks.description: The image shows a figure from the back holding an open book in their right hand. The person's head is slightly tilted forward, suggesting engagement with the book. The figure has curly hair and a halo around their head. They wear a long robe, with visible layers underneath and bare feet. Additionally, they carry a staff over their left shoulder. The background includes two tree stumps and leafy plants. The image is a monochrome engraving with the text "S. IACOBVS 1545 ISB" running vertically on the left.

artworks.title: Saint John
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body depiction of a person standing upright, facing slightly to the right. They have curly, medium-length hair and wear a long robe with a cloak. The robe is detailed with a textured fabric. The person holds a large cup in their right hand, with a serpent emerging from it. They wear sandals. In the background, there are scattered bricks and stones with sparse vegetation. A halo of lines radiates from the person's head. There are inscriptions on either side of the figure, with "S. IOHANNES" on the right and "ISB" on the left.

artworks.title: Saint Philip
artworks.description: The image shows a barefoot male holding a staff with a cross in his right hand and a scroll in his left hand. He has a long beard and short, slightly curled hair. He wears a robe that covers his body from shoulders to feet, with folds indicating movement. The background is plain with some plants near his feet on a rocky surface. Text is present in the upper left corner and the year "1545" is inscribed on the left side of the image.

artworks.title: Saint Bartholomew
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing. He is positioned facing slightly to the right, with his head turned slightly to his left. The man has facial features including a bushy beard and wavy, tousled hair. He is clad in a flowing robe with voluminous sleeves and a draped outer garment, which he holds in his left hand. His right hand holds a large, curved knife with the blade pointing downward. The man is barefoot, and his feet stand on uneven ground covered with pebbles. Surrounding him are tufts of grass and a few plants. Several rectangular stone blocks are at his feet. The background has hatching lines suggesting radiant light emanating from behind. To the left of the figure, the text "S. BARTHOLOMEVS" is inscribed vertically.

artworks.title: Saint Thomas
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing upright. His head is framed with radiating lines. The man has a full beard and wavy hair, and he is cloaked in a draped garment. He holds a long staff in his right hand. The background depicts a simple outdoor setting with rocks and plants. The style of the image is reminiscent of an engraved or illustrated artwork, with inscriptions on the left side reading "S. THOMAS" and on the right side reading "ISB."

artworks.title: Saint Matthew
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length portrait of a standing male figure wearing a long robe and holding a sword with both hands. He has an aged face with a beard and serious expression, and his head is covered with a hood or cloth. The background includes sparse vegetation and rocks. A halo-like aura surrounds his head. Text on the image includes "S. MATHEVS" on the left, and "1546" and "ISB" on the right.

artworks.title: Saint James the Great
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing, facing forward, with his body slightly angled to the right. He holds a long staff in his right hand and a book on his left arm. The man has a bearded face with a soft, brimless hat featuring an emblem. He wears a long cloak, tunic, and a satchel across his chest, with bare feet. The cloak has intricate folds, and he carries a large circular object at his waist. The background has a wooden fence and foliage, with no other elements present.
